title: Gemini hit a billion users
angle: Market shape. Being best did not drive the adoption. Stat-led.

frames.text: Gemini hit a billion users. It isn't the best model.
Announced August 11. The 14th Google product to reach a billion.
When it crossed the same line. Two months earlier.
The best model didn't win this. The most available one did.
Demand for AI isn't sitting at the frontier. It's everywhere.
